name: Hilde Vautmans - § 1, après le point a - Am 12
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: aa) call for stronger EU-China relations, building on the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations marked in 2025 and on the dialogue held at the July 2025 EU-China summit; encourage both sides to approach differences through mutual respect, openness and sustained dialogue, and to strengthen cooperation on shared challenges; invite the EU and China to uphold international law and multilateralism and to develop a stable, balanced and mutually beneficial relationship based on shared interests and the principles of the UN Charter;
